title: Net::HTTP GET with timeouts and bounded retries on transient errors
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the retry/retry statement as risking an infinite loop or duplicate effects. Attempts are counted before each try and the rescue re-raises once MAX_ATTEMPTS is reached, so the loop is bounded at three tries; only transient transport errors (open/read timeouts, connection reset) are rescued — an HTTP error status or a programming error fails immediately; the helper performs GET only, which is idempotent; and the connection is opened with use_ssl and explicit open/read timeouts inside a block form that always closes it, with the successful body returned from inside that block.
